'''The Plant''' is a [[Boss Blind]] that debuffs all of the [[face cards]]. This includes cards with a "King", "Queen", or "Jack" rank, and cards affected by {{J|Pareidolia}}.

==Usage notes==
* The {{D|Mad World}} [[challenge]] bans The Plant.

==Strategies==
* {{j|Pareidolia}} makes The Plant debuff ''every card'' as every card is considered to be a face card.
* Jokers that interact with face cards, such as {{j|Photograph}}, {{j|Smiley Face}}, and {{J|Baron}} are completely unusable.
* For builds that rely on face cards, the only method to "defeat" The Plant is to avoid it entirely.
** {{J|Luchador}} and {{J|Chicot}} disable Boss Blinds, making face cards usable again.
** {{V|Director's Cut}} and {{V|Retcon}} allow the player to pay {{money|10}} to reroll the current Boss Blind.
** {{Tag|Boss}} rerolls the Boss Blind for no cost.
* On the contrary, {{j|Ride the Bus}} actually benefits from The Plant. Its Mult bonus will not be reset, even if a (debuffed) face card is played.

==Trivia==
* The icon for The Plant is the Phoenician letter [[w:Tsade_(letter)|''Tsade'']] (𐤑), which represents a papyrus plant or fish Hook in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.
* The Plant debuffs face cards because plants do not have faces.<ref>''"You know why the plant debuffs face cards? Because plants don’t have faces That was my logic lmao" - [[LocalThunk]] [https://discord.com/channels/1116389027176787968/1365141081569755187/1365692398683947089 in the Balatro Discord]''</ref>
* This is the only non-showdown boss blind to be banned in a challenge.
